name: electerm-widget-tftp
description: Serve a folder over TFTP from electerm — for routers, switches, PXE boot and other gear that has no better protocol.
author: ZHAO Xudong

scripts.lint: node --check main.js && node --check lib/server.js && node --check lib/packet.js && node --check lib/safe-path.js && node --check lib/block-reader.js && node --check lib/netascii.js

electerm.name: Local TFTP Server
electerm.description: Serve a folder over TFTP for routers, switches, PXE boot and other gear that has no better protocol.
electerm.author: ZHAO Xudong

configs.name: host
configs.label: Listen address
configs.description: The interface to bind to. 0.0.0.0 listens on every network the machine has, which is what a router on the LAN needs.

configs.name: port
configs.label: Port
configs.description: TFTP uses UDP port 69, and binding below 1024 needs root — electerm runs as your user, so 6969 is the default. Point the client at this port.

configs.name: directory
configs.label: Served folder
configs.description: The folder clients can read from (and write to, if uploads are enabled). Leave empty for ~/tftp; it is created if it does not exist.

configs.name: allowWrite
configs.label: Allow uploads
configs.description: Accept WRQ requests, so clients can push files into the served folder. Off by default: TFTP has no password, so anyone who can reach the port could write.

configs.name: overwrite
configs.label: Overwrite existing files
configs.description: Only matters with uploads enabled. When off, an upload to a name that already exists is refused with "file already exists".

configs.name: maxBlockSize
configs.label: Max block size
configs.description: Upper bound for the blksize option (RFC 2348). 1468 keeps each packet inside a 1500 byte MTU; raise it on a network with jumbo frames, lower it if packets are dropped.

configs.name: timeout
configs.label: Timeout (seconds)
configs.description: How long to wait for the next packet before retransmitting it.

configs.name: retries
configs.label: Retries
configs.description: How many retransmissions before a transfer is abandoned.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Start with electerm
configs.description: Start this server when electerm starts, so it is already up when a device on the LAN asks for a file.

zh_cn.name: 本地 TFTP 服务器
zh_cn.description: 通过 TFTP 提供文件夹，供路由器、交换机、PXE 启动及其他没有更好协议的设备使用。

host.label: 监听地址
host.description: 绑定的网络接口。0.0.0.0 会监听本机所有网络，局域网内的路由器需要它。

port.label: 端口
port.description: TFTP 使用 UDP 69 端口，而绑定 1024 以下端口需要 root 权限——electerm 以你的用户身份运行，所以默认 6969。客户端请指向这个端口。

directory.label: 共享文件夹
directory.description: 客户端可以读取的文件夹（启用上传时也可写入）。留空则使用 ~/tftp；不存在时会自动创建。

allowWrite.label: 允许上传
allowWrite.description: 接受 WRQ 请求，客户端可以把文件推送到共享文件夹。默认关闭：TFTP 没有密码，任何能访问端口的人都可以写入。

overwrite.label: 覆盖已有文件
overwrite.description: 仅在启用上传时有效。关闭时，上传同名文件会被拒绝并提示“文件已存在”。

maxBlockSize.label: 最大块大小
maxBlockSize.description: blksize 选项的上限（RFC 2348）。1468 可让每个包保持在 1500 字节 MTU 内；网络支持巨型帧可调大，丢包则调小。

timeout.label: 超时（秒）
timeout.description: 重传前等待下一个包的时间。

retries.label: 重试次数
retries.description: 放弃传输前的重传次数。

autoRun.label: 随 electerm 启动
autoRun.description: electerm 启动时就运行本服务，这样局域网设备请求文件时它已经就绪。
